step0.title: Launcher language
step0.body: Pick a language for the launcher. You can change it later in Settings.
step0.label: Language

step1.title: Game files
step1.body: Point the launcher at your Firewall Zero Hour dump: European release CUSA11182, update 1.43. PKG files or an extracted folder both work.
step1.needUpdate: Base game found. Now choose the 1.43 update folder.
step1.needBase: Update found. Now choose the base game folder.
step1.prepAuto: Runs automatically once the game is recognised
step1.installWait: Runs once the base game and update are recognised

step2.title: Game language
step2.body: Pick the language for the in-game text. Default keeps whatever the game already uses.
step2.label: Language

step3.title: Account
step3.body: Create an account on the {server}, or sign in with your recovery code.
step3.recoveryPlaceholder: Only to sign in to an account you already have

step4.title: Ready
step4.bodyReady: Hit PLAY at the bottom of the menu.
step4.bodyNotReady: A few steps are still open: finish them any time from the launcher.

toast.skipped: Run the setup again any time from Settings

play.title: Game
play.accountInUseNote: {id} is signed in from another launcher, a running game or another PC. Close it there, then press PLAY.
play.firewallNote: On the first launch Windows may ask if the emulator can use networks. Choose Allow (at least private networks) so friends can connect to you.
play.dumpIntro: Choose the folder with your Firewall Zero Hour dump: European release CUSA11182, update 1.43. PKG files or an extracted folder.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Audio, language and shortcuts. Changes take effect on the next launch.
settings.setupNote: Walk through game files and account step by step.

graphics.title: Graphics
graphics.subtitle: Tune the picture in your headset. Changes take effect on the next launch.

mods.title: Mods
mods.subtitle: Optional changes to the game. All off by default.

gamepad.title: Gamepad
gamepad.subtitle: Pick a controller and adjust where the rifle sits in your hand.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.subtitle: Private server settings. Most players do not need this page.
advanced.nothingToSetUp: Nothing to set up: sign in and play.
advanced.cannotReachOfficial: Cannot reach the community server. Check your connection.
advanced.privateEnterAddress: Type the address and save. The launcher checks whether the server responds.
advanced.privateAskOwner: {address} — ask the owner if it stays offline.
advanced.hostOnNote: Friends who choose this PC as their private server connect here. Takes effect at once.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Versions, licences and help.
about.updateSeeChanges: Read the changes, then download the update.
about.updateUnavailable: Automatic updates are not available yet. New versions come from whoever gave you the launcher.
about.updateIdle: The launcher checks for updates each time it starts.
about.readyNote: The launcher closes, installs the update and reopens.
about.compatibilityNote: Works with Firewall Zero Hour for PS4: European release CUSA11182, update 1.43. {app} is a community project, not affiliated with or endorsed by the game's developer or publisher. You need your own copy.
about.reportNote: Saves the logs into one file you can send for troubleshooting.
about.setupNote: Walk through the first-launch setup again.

profile.title: Profile
profile.onlineIdNote: The name your friends see. Renaming is not available yet.
profile.recoveryNote: The recovery code was shown once when the account was created. Without it, only the server operator can help.
profile.avatarNote: A colour with your initials, or your own picture. Other players see it in the game.
profile.recoveryNotSet: Not set. Without one, a lost password cannot be recovered.
profile.signOutNote: Your friends will see you as offline.

friends.title: Friends
friends.subtitle: See who is online and send friend requests.
friends.notSignedInNote: Sign in to see your friends.
friends.invitedYou: {name} invited you. Start the game to respond.

shell.tipChooseFolder: Choose the game folder first: open {screen}
shell.tipAccountInUse: Your account is in use elsewhere: close the other launcher or game first
shell.srvHosting: Private server on this PC · Hosting

microphone.label: Microphone
microphone.note: Voice input for the game. Off mutes your mic.

audioOutput.label: Output
audioOutput.note: Plays game audio and your friends' voices.

gameLanguage.label: Game language
gameLanguage.note: Language of the in-game text. Not verified on every screen yet.

gripRight.label: Grip: right
gripRight.note: Shifts the rifle to the right.

gripPitch.label: Tilt: up
gripPitch.note: Tilts the muzzle upward. Negative values tilt it down.

gripYaw.label: Tilt: right
gripYaw.note: Turns the muzzle to the right. Negative values turn it left.

gripRoll.label: Tilt: roll
gripRoll.note: Rolls the rifle clockwise. Negative values roll it counterclockwise.

frameRate.label: Frame rate
frameRate.note: Match your headset refresh rate. 90 recommended.

asyncShaders.label: Background shader compilation
asyncShaders.note: Prevents stutter. Some objects may pop in a few frames late.

sharpness.label: Sharpness
sharpness.note: Counteracts the softness from TAA and upscaling.

fieldOfView.label: Field of view
fieldOfView.note: Narrower means sharper, with a black border.

shadowQuality.label: Dynamic shadows
shadowQuality.note: Off removes the shadows of moving objects. The maps use precomputed lighting, so the difference is small.

antialiasing.label: Antialiasing
antialiasing.note: Default: none, as on a base PS4. TAA smooths the most but softens the image: raise Sharpness to compensate. MSAA stays sharp, with a subtle effect.

fpsCounter.label: FPS counter
fpsCounter.note: Frames per second, shown in the game window.

modFreeTurn.label: Disable the FACE CAMERA warning
modFreeTurn.note: Removes the FACE CAMERA text and arrows that cover the view when you turn your back. Applies the next time the game starts.

usePrivateServer.label: Use a private server
usePrivateServer.note: Off: you play on the community server.

privateServer.label: Server address
privateServer.note: Paste the address exactly as the owner gave it to you.

relay.label: Connection relay
relay.note: Helps friends connect when the direct route fails.

keyNote: These shortcuts work on the game window on the monitor.
licence: Farpoint PC VR fork of shadPS4 (github.com/evertec82/Farpoint)

check.title: Button check · last session
check.note: Start the game, press every button once, close the game and come back here. A green dot means the game received that button.

cache.title: Shader cache
cache.warmingNote: The game opens in a window on the monitor and plays a solo TRAINING match by itself, about {minutes} minutes per round. Keep the headset off and leave the PC alone until it finishes.
cache.emptyNote: The first few matches compile shaders in the background: some objects may pop in late.
cache.generalNote: The warm-up opens the game and lets it play solo TRAINING matches to compile shaders before you play.{total} Keep the headset off and leave the PC alone.
cache.totalTime: Each round takes about {round} minutes ({min}–{max} total). It stops after two quiet rounds in a row.

warmupBlocker.scriptMissing: A required file is missing. Reinstall the launcher.
warmupBlocker.noFolder: Choose your game folder on the Game screen.
warmupBlocker.installing: Wait for the installation to finish.
warmupBlocker.preparing: Wait for the game files to finish preparing.
warmupBlocker.notSignedIn: Sign in first (Profile screen). The warm-up plays online.
warmupBlocker.serverOffline: The server is unreachable right now. Try again later.

install.pkgNote: The PKG files are extracted once. The originals are not changed.
install.waitForRecognition: Runs once the base game and update are recognised.
install.installedCopyNote: Extracted from your PKG files into {target}. Deleting frees {size}; you can reinstall any time.
install.leftoverNote: {target}: installed earlier, not used by the game folder you picked now.

gameSteps.noFolderChosen: No folder chosen yet. Pick a folder with PKG files, the base game, or both base and update.
gameSteps.prepAutoWaitPkg: Runs once the game is installed.
gameSteps.prepAutoWait: Runs once the base game and update are recognised. Your dump is not changed.
gameSteps.needUpdatePkg: Base game found. Now pick the 1.43 update (PKG or extracted folder).
gameSteps.needBasePkg: Update found. Now pick the base game (PKG or extracted folder).

log.idle: Pick your game folder to get started.
log.title: Log

event.headsetWaiting: OpenXR: {runtime} has no headset connected. The game starts in a window. If your headset runs through a different program, set that one as the active OpenXR runtime and start the game again.
event.updatesOff: Updates are off: this build has no update key.
event.alreadyExtracted: The game is already extracted there. Nothing to do.
event.linkedSeparate: Base game and update linked. Nothing copied.
event.preparingNow: The game files are not prepared. Preparing them now.
event.installStarted: Installing {total} into {target} ({required} to write, {present} already there)
event.installCancelled: Installation paused. The {size} extracted so far stay for next time.

installDeletedKept.one: Installed copy deleted from {target} ({size} freed). One other file there was kept.
installDeletedKept.other: Installed copy deleted from {target} ({size} freed). {count} other files there were kept.

event.modPakWarmup: Mod pak rebuilt for a one-player lobby
event.modPakRebuilt: Mod pak rebuilt for the new settings
event.serverRefused: The server turned the launcher away: {reason}
event.accountCarriedOver: The community server has moved. Your account {id} has been carried over.
event.accountRefused: The server no longer accepts the account {id}. Signed out.
event.handoverToGame: Launcher signed out so the game can sign in
event.playGrantNotOffered: This server does not ask the launcher to confirm the player
event.playGrantFailed: The server did not confirm the account for this game: {reason}
event.vaultFailed: The account could not be stored in the Windows Credential Manager: {reason}
event.warmupStarted: Warm-up started: up to {rounds} rounds of {duration}. It stops early once the cache is full.
event.warmupReady: Warm-up done after {count} rounds. The shader cache is ready.

warmupCancelled.one: Warm-up cancelled after one complete round

event.warmupFailNoMatch: the game did not reach a match twice in a row
event.warmupFailSignIn: the game could not sign in to the server twice in a row
event.pakRestoreFailed: Warm-up: the mod pak could not be restored ({reason}). The next launch rebuilds it.

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.body: Save your changes before leaving this screen?

stopGame.title: Stop the game?
stopGame.body: The game closes. You leave any match in progress.

changeFolder.title: Change game folder?
changeFolder.body: Pick a new dump folder. The launcher prepares the game again; your files are not touched.
changeFolder.bodyInstall: The installed copy in {target} ({size}) stays on disk.

deleteInstall.title: Delete installed copy?
deleteInstall.body: Removes {size} from {target}. Your PKG files are untouched: you can reinstall any time.

discardChanges.title: Discard changes?
discardChanges.body: All settings go back to their last saved values.

changeOnlineId.title: Change Online ID?
changeOnlineId.body: Your friends will see you as {newId} instead of {oldId}.

changeServer.title: Change server?
changeServer.bodyPrivate: You will be signed out of this server. Accounts and friends are separate on each server. This PC remembers your account on each one, so if you signed in on {address} before you will be signed in there again.
changeServer.bodyOfficial: You will be signed out of this server. Accounts and friends are separate on each server. This PC remembers your account on each one, so if you signed in on the community server before you will be signed in there again.

stopHosting.title: Stop hosting?
stopHosting.body: Everyone connected to this PC drops out of their match.

report.title: Report a problem
report.body: Creates a text file with the information you pick. Nothing is sent anywhere: you share the file yourself. Your password is never included, and network addresses and your Windows user name are replaced by placeholders.
report.placeholder: What you were doing and what went wrong
report.attachSystem: Include system info (GPU, driver, Windows version)
report.issueNote: To report it to the project, open an issue on GitHub and attach the saved file.

reportSaved.title: Report saved
reportSaved.body: Saved as {filename}. To report it, open an issue on GitHub and attach this file.

updateNotes.title: What's new in {version}
updateNotes.body: You have {current}. After the download you choose when to restart.

restartUpdate.title: Restart to update?
restartUpdate.body: The launcher closes, installs {version} and reopens.

signOut.title: Sign out?
signOut.body: Your friends will see you as offline.
signOut.bodyUnsaved: Your friends will see you as offline. Unsaved profile changes are lost.

createAccount.title: Create account
createAccount.body: Choose the name other players see. The launcher stores your account on this PC and gives you a recovery code you can use on other PCs.

recoveryCode.title: Your recovery code
recoveryCode.body: Save this code somewhere safe. It is the only way to sign in on another PC or after reinstalling, and it cannot be shown again.

recoveryEmail.body: Used only to reset a lost password.
recoveryEmail.label: Email

removeAvatar.title: Remove image?
removeAvatar.body: Goes back to a colour with your initials.

declineFriend.title: Decline {name}?
declineFriend.body: The request is removed. {name} can send another one later.

removeFriend.title: Remove {name}?
removeFriend.body: {name} leaves your list. You will need to send a new request to add them back.

cancelWarmup.title: Cancel warm-up?
cancelWarmup.body: The game window closes. Shaders compiled so far stay in the cache.

clearCache.title: Clear shader cache?
clearCache.body: Shaders recompile during the next matches: objects may pop in late until the cache fills again.

backend.friend_blocked: One of you has blocked the other.
backend.friend_already: Already your friend, or your request is still waiting.
backend.progress_unreachable: The server is online but progress is not syncing. Try again later.
